info.name: CSEDU Students' Club API
info.description: Complete Postman Collection v2.1 for CSEDU Students' Club Management System. Includes API Gateway and microservice endpoints (MS1 Auth & Users, MS2 Elections, MS3 Events/Notices/Media/Gallery, MS4 Finance/Notifications/Logs) with request bodies, path params, query params, auth headers, and response examples.
